scope: Artificial complete-key memory, not natural language, novel labels, P1/S1 synchronization, partial context, brain model, or SS-only control. Prediction eligibility false. No replay, no self-teaching, and no learner access to evaluation truth or never-taught examples.
teacher_stream: Previous online protocol on fresh data seeds: A/B/C64 each four passes, A once,16 changed A labels four passes;896 externally supplied artificial teacher labels. Eight incorrect A labels only on first pass in noisy_first. All architectures see the same order and labels. Each learned known label implies zero targets for the other three known labels, but no never-taught key is taught as negative.
architectures_detail: single128/512 use one reader. concat512 has four128 blocks sharing the mean residual, algebraically a single concatenated512 vector. multi4 updates each independent128 reader with its own residual. clone4 copies the same128 code into four separate readers. checked has three independent128 readers and a separate512-component joint context*label pair memory, with simultaneous residual updates for four candidate pairs. exact saves last teacher per key.
budget: single512, concat512, multi4, clone4, checked each2048 complex128 learned coefficients=32768 bytes. single128 has512=8192 bytes. Warm symbol caches, metadata and compute differ and must be reported. checked uses4*512 additional pair correlations per feedback; it is not a same-FLOP design. No ordinary teacher replay buffer.
policies: Fixed mean threshold0.5 with exactly one hit. Candidate is mean argmax with gap>1e-12. Fixed quorum requires ceil(0.75*K) banks individually having exactly one score>=0.5 and matching the mean candidate; unanimity usesK. Fixed pair-check requires exactly one check score>=0.5 and the same candidate. Gates only reject; they cannot repair a tentative label by themselves.
calibration: Two development data seeds, code-dev, clean; A4/B4/C4 snapshots. Known keys only for correct/wrong calibration, plus128 never-taught keys per snapshot for absence calibration. This extra known/unknown validation supervision is shared across all architectures, never used to update H, and separately disclosed. Select among threshold0.25..1.25 step0.05, quorum0..K (single/exact only0), checker none/0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0 when available. Constrain pooled unknown false acceptance<=1% and accepted-known error<=1%, maximize known correct, then fewer unknown accepts, fewer known errors, then earlier grid index. Explicit reject-all fallback. Selection before final evaluation; no tuning using final data. No probabilistic guarantee from calibration.
reporting: All fixed and frozen calibrated policies, tentative accuracy, accepted correct/wrong/abstain, never-taught false acceptance, anchors lost, noisy-teacher recovery, changed versus unchanged A. Publish development grid and full raw test scores. Gates require reporting discarded correct answers; do not call abstention error correction. Repeated probes not independent tasks. Equal-dimensional baseline and exact control; no requirement multi-code wins.
execution: 104 final trajectories:96 SS (4 data*2 codes*2 scenarios*6 architectures) plus8 exact. Each896 teachers and19 fixed snapshots. Two full runs. Verify raw metrics, selected calibration, independent sequential replay and predictor-only isolation. Freeze implementation, tests, protocol, cases and selected policy before final runs.
